summary.zh: 9 年互联网产品经验，经历餐饮 SaaS、企业业务中台与跨境电商供应链三条业务线，覆盖商品开发、交易、会员营销、数据与质量等业务域；以领域建模驱动复杂业务系统的重构与模块化演进，擅长把分散的业务诉求抽象为可复用的领域模型、规则体系与平台能力，并以可量化的业务收益验证方案；具备 0 到 1 产品落地与大型连锁品牌数字化解决方案的实践经验。近年自主探索 AI 产品与应用场景，实践 Prompt 工程与 AI 辅助开发。
summary.en: Product manager with 9 years of experience across restaurant SaaS, enterprise business middle platform and cross-border e-commerce supply chain, covering product development, transaction, membership & marketing, data and quality domains. Drives the refactoring and modular evolution of complex business systems through domain modeling, strong at abstracting fragmented business requirements into reusable domain models, rule systems and platform capabilities, and validating solutions against quantified business outcomes; hands-on experience in zero-to-one product delivery and digital solutions for large chain brands. In recent years, independently exploring AI products and use cases through prompt engineering and AI-assisted development.
